howItWorks.headline: Use the feed in three steps

steps.title: Connect your LinkedIn account
steps.body: Sign in with LinkedIn to see posts shared by other members. When you choose to react or comment, you finish the action on LinkedIn.

steps.title: Join relevant conversations
steps.body: React to and comment on posts that matter in your field. A little regular activity helps people recognize your name and work.

steps.title: Track your LinkedIn activity
steps.body: Your weekly recap records the reactions and comments you make and receive. We don't add our own score or promise a result.

ssiExplainer.intro: LinkedIn's Social Selling Index scores four parts of your LinkedIn activity from 0 to 25: your professional brand, finding the right people, engaging with insights, and building relationships.

pillars.title: Establish your brand
pillars.body: Complete your profile and share useful work so people understand what you do.

pillars.title: Find the right people
pillars.body: Connect with decision-makers and peers in your field instead of adding people at random.

pillars.title: Engage with insight
pillars.body: React and comment on topics you know well.

pillars.title: Build relationships
pillars.body: Stay in touch to turn connections into real professional relationships.

ssiExplainer.sourceLine: Four areas, 25 points each, recalculated daily.

items.q: Does the app act on my LinkedIn account?
items.a: No. The app shows you a post or copies a draft, then you complete each reaction, comment, or post on LinkedIn yourself.

items.q: How is this different from automation or spam?
items.a: Automation performs actions in bulk. Here, you choose one post at a time and complete each action yourself on LinkedIn. There are no bots, bulk actions, or auto-posting.

items.q: What does the free trial include, and when am I charged?
items.a: The trial includes the plan you choose. A card is required. It is free until 50 interactions made or received, as recorded in the app, or for up to 7 days, whichever comes first. Cancel before then and you pay nothing.

items.q: What is SSI, and how fast will it move?
items.a: Your Social Selling Index is LinkedIn's 0–100 score across four areas: professional brand, the right people, insights, and relationships. LinkedIn recalculates it daily. We neither access nor predict it, and we don't promise a timeline. The app gives you a feed for joining conversations and a recap of your interactions. Since August 2026, the SSI page has required Sales Navigator.

items.q: Do I need to be active every day?
items.a: No. Use the feed on a schedule you can maintain. LinkedIn recalculates SSI daily, but we do not promise how quickly yours will change.
Yes. Cancel from your subscription page. There are no contracts or cancellation fees, and access continues until the end of the current period.

items.q: Why is Link Into The SSI the best way to be noticed on LinkedIn?
items.a: It brings the posts that matter in your field into one feed, helps you write a comment worth reading, and records the reactions and comments you make and receive. That activity is how people learn your name. That is why members use Link Into The SSI to be known on LinkedIn and to engage with the important people in their industry.

items.q: Can Link Into The SSI help me get a job faster?
items.a: Link Into The SSI makes it faster and easier to stay visible where hiring conversations happen. Your next role often comes from people who already know your work. It puts you in front of those conversations. We promise no timeline and no specific result. What you do on LinkedIn is always yours.
